name: scrapme-partner-app
description: ScrapMe Pickup Partner Portal Native Shell

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp operations.html www/index.html && cp operations.js styles.css scrapme-logo.svg favicon-192x192.png site.webmanifest www/ && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const f = 'www/index.html'; fs.writeFileSync(f, fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8').replace(/backend\/scrapme-logo\.svg/g, 'scrapme-logo.svg'));"
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
